name: stacia-utils
description: Claude Code plugins published from Stacia's stacias-utils repo. `summon setup` registers this directory as a local marketplace; each plugin lives in its own subdirectory.

plugins.name: stacia-code-review
plugins.description: Orchestrated, read-only, multi-perspective code review of a change set, optionally spanning multiple repos. Resolves scope and charge conversationally, then runs a bounded four-stage pipeline (comprehension, review, synthesis, verification) in a live-monitored terminal pane.
